features.name: Rocky River Nature Center
features.description: Rocky River Nature Center is the staffed visitor center above the Rocky River, with indoor geology and wildlife exhibits, a river-view deck, HideAway Hollow children's play, restrooms and direct access to more than five miles of trails and Fort Hill Stairs.

features.name: Berea Falls Scenic Overlook
features.description: Berea Falls Scenic Overlook is the named roadside and trail viewpoint above the East Branch Rocky River waterfall, with a small lot that also stages cyclists for the reservation's all-purpose trail.
features.source_label: Cleveland Metroparks Berea Falls Scenic Overlook
